info.description: Exported from the public Postman workspace https://www.postman.com/hakkotsu/ryanair/overview (collection 5803268-7bd93177-aa05-4cb2-aed9-ed27e693f83e). All requests are unauthenticated GETs against https://www.ryanair.com.

request.description: Full airport catalogue: IATA code, name, city, region, country (ISO2/ISO3, currency, schengen flag), latitude/longitude and IANA timeZone. Use this as the offline airport master table.
Older shape of the airport catalogue. v5 is preferred.
Airports near the caller's IP, ordered by proximity.

Every route served from {{origin}}. Returns an array of objects with arrivalAirport (full airport object incl. coordinates and timeZone), recent flag, seasonal flag, operator and tags. This is the edge list of the Ryanair route graph.

request.description: Country list with ISO codes. Needed to support 'fly me to <country>' searches that fan out over every airport in that country.
